pathRules: All module paths and assetBase values resolve from this directory; item asset paths resolve against their file assetBase.

selectionSemantics.all: Every listed tag must be present.
selectionSemantics.any: Empty means unrestricted; otherwise at least one must be present.
selectionSemantics.exclude: No listed tag may be present.
selectionSemantics.context: Use tile.tags plus explicitly supplied time/weather tags. Never infer tags from filenames.
selectionSemantics.weights: Filter eligible entries first; normalize positive weights among survivors. No eligible entries means no result.
selectionSemantics.emptyPool: An empty pool intentionally draws zero items.
selectionSemantics.independence: Select battle art layers independently. Enemy weights are defined only in encounter pools.

scope: Example coordinates do not locate any production world nodes; no engine integration or automatic assignment. Map terrain pools remain null until actual 512px hex ground exports exist.

composition.hexRotationAppliesTo: local edge topology only; sprite rotation is separately authored
